requirement_text: The goal of Technical Specification is to inform the Client about implementation details of the system.
rationale: The sentence states the goal of a document and describes no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: What implementation details must the Technical Specification contain?
Is this a requirement on the system or a statement about a document?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to serve 20,000 queries/day, with a significant portion during the 4 peak traffic hours.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to serve 20,000 queries per day, with a significant portion during the 4 peak traffic hours, so that it copes with its daily demand.
technical_task: Size the system to serve 20,000 queries per day, including a significant portion during the 4 peak traffic hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal day, when 20,000 queries are submitted, then the system serves them.
Given the 4 peak traffic hours, when a significant portion of the day's queries arrives, then the system serves those queries.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. "Significant portion" is not quantified.

requirement_text: Displayed is a list of all the forms associated with this encounter.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to see a list of all forms associated with an encounter, so that I can find them in one place.
technical_task: Display a list of all the forms associated with the current encounter.
acceptance_criteria: Given an encounter with associated forms, when the encounter is opened, then a list of all its forms is displayed.
Given an encounter with no forms, when the encounter is opened, then the list is empty.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician.

requirement_text: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210©.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want a message digest created according to the standard in 170.210, so that data integrity can be checked.
technical_task: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in 170.210.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be protected, when a message digest is created, then it follows the standard specified in 170.210.
Given a message digest, when it is reviewed, then it conforms to the standard in 170.210.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The standard itself is only referenced; the section symbol in the source text is garbled.

requirement_text: The system shall have the ability to record or capture information about each authorized possibly and possibly unauthorized access attempt such as: User ID workstation date time transaction (menu screen file object) and attempted type of access (read modify etc.).
requirement_text_raw: The system shall have the ability to record or capture information about each authorized possibly and possibly unauthorized access attempt such as: User ID  workstation  date  time  transaction (menu  screen  file  object)  and attempted type of access (read  modify  etc.).
user_story: As a security administrator, I want each authorized and possibly unauthorized access attempt recorded with user ID, workstation, date, time, transaction and attempted access type, so that access can be reviewed.
technical_task: Record each access attempt, authorized or possibly unauthorized, with the user ID, workstation, date, time, transaction (menu screen file object) and attempted type of access such as read or modify.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized access attempt, when it occurs, then the user ID, workstation, date, time, transaction and attempted type of access are recorded.
Given a possibly unauthorized access attempt, when it occurs, then the same information is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: security administrator.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to de-identify extracted information.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to de-identify extracted information, so that individuals cannot be recognized from it.
technical_task: Provide a de-identification function for extracted information.
acceptance_criteria: Given extracted information, when the user requests de-identification, then the information is de-identified.
Given de-identified information, when it is reviewed, then it no longer shows the identifying details that were removed.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The identifiers to remove are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall maintain backward compatibility and smooth dependency installation.
rationale: "Smooth" is subjective and the compatibility scope is not stated.
clarification_questions: Which versions must remain backward compatible?
What makes dependency installation "smooth"?

requirement_text: If answer to security question is correct allow user to change their password.
requirement_text_raw: If answer to security question is correct  allow user to change their password.
user_story: As a user who forgot my password, I want to change it when I answer my security question correctly, so that I can regain access.
technical_task: Allow a user to change their password once the answer to the security question is correct.
acceptance_criteria: Given a correct answer to the security question, when the user asks to change the password, then the password change is allowed.
Given an incorrect answer to the security question, when the user asks to change the password, then the change is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user who forgot the password.

requirement_text: Effective content delivery is ensured through SLA satisfaction.
rationale: The sentence claims an outcome without a testable behaviour; "effective" and the SLA are undefined.
clarification_questions: Which SLA and what service levels are meant?
What must the system do for content delivery to be "effective"?

requirement_text: User shall/will have passwords stored securely using industry-standard hashing algorithms.
user_story: As a user, I want my password stored securely with an industry-standard hashing algorithm, so that it cannot be read if the data is exposed.
technical_task: Store user passwords hashed with an industry-standard hashing algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets a password, when it is stored, then it is stored as a hash made with an industry-standard hashing algorithm.
Given the stored data, when it is inspected, then the password cannot be read in plain text.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The specific algorithm is not named.

requirement_text: The page also includes links to the patient's medical history documents etc. at the top of the screen as well as a list of "issues" associated with that patient and any appointments they may have scheduled in a column along the righthand side.
requirement_text_raw: The page also includes links to the patient's medical history  documents  etc. at the top of the screen  as well as a list of "issues" associated with that patient  and any appointments they may have scheduled in a column along the righthand side.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the page to show links to the patient's medical history documents at the top, and the issues and appointments in a column on the right, so that I can see the patient's overview.
technical_task: Lay out the patient page with links to medical history documents at the top and a righthand column listing the patient's issues and scheduled appointments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient page, when it is displayed, then links to the patient's medical history documents appear at the top of the screen.
Given a patient page, when it is displayed, then the issues and any scheduled appointments are listed in a column along the righthand side.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician.

requirement_text: Calendar scheduling for meetings shall be provided.
user_story: As a team member, I want calendar scheduling for meetings, so that I can plan meetings with others.
technical_task: Provide calendar scheduling for meetings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the calendar, when a user schedules a meeting, then the meeting appears on the calendar.
Given a scheduled meeting, when the calendar is viewed, then the meeting is displayed at its scheduled time.
rationale: Role assumed: team member.

requirement_text: Delivery boys shall acknowledge requests within 3 seconds.
user_story: As a customer, I want delivery staff to acknowledge my request within 3 seconds, so that I know it has been received.
technical_task: Require delivery staff to acknowledge each request within 3 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request is sent to a delivery boy, when the delivery boy responds, then the acknowledgement happens within 3 seconds.
Given a request that is not acknowledged, when 3 seconds have passed, then the request is flagged as unacknowledged.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an assumption about how a miss is handled.

requirement_text: System shall provide an option for users to set up automatic email forwarding rules.
user_story: As an email user, I want to set up automatic email forwarding rules, so that messages reach the right address without my action.
technical_task: Provide an option to create automatic email forwarding rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user creates a forwarding rule, then the rule is saved.
Given a saved forwarding rule, when a matching email arrives, then it is forwarded automatically.
rationale: Role assumed: email user.

requirement_text: Invoices can be sent to companies, and featured employer showcases can be managed.
user_story: As an employer administrator, I want to send invoices to companies and manage featured employer showcases, so that billing and promotion are handled in one place.
technical_task: Implement invoice sending to companies and management of featured employer showcases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company, when an invoice is sent to it, then the company receives the invoice.
Given a featured employer showcase, when it is managed, then the changes are saved.
rationale: Role assumed: employer administrator.

requirement_text: The solution should retain date or time or user stamp of original data entry person when data entered on behalf of another author.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the date, time or user stamp of the original data entry person kept when data is entered on behalf of another author, so that the original entry is traceable.
technical_task: Retain the date, time or user stamp of the original data entry person when data is entered on behalf of another author.
acceptance_criteria: Given data entered on behalf of another author, when it is saved, then the date or time or user stamp of the original data entry person is retained.
Given saved data, when the auditor views it, then the original data entry person's stamp is visible.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall provide ways for users to give feedback, such as ratings or comments, to improve the site's offerings.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to give feedback such as ratings or comments, so that the site's offerings can improve.
technical_task: Provide ways for users to submit ratings or comments about the site's offerings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor, when the visitor submits a rating, then the rating is saved.
Given a visitor, when the visitor submits a comment, then the comment is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor.

requirement_text: System shall provide secure access to confidential data, such as user details, by utilizing SSL encryption.
user_story: As a user, I want confidential data such as my user details to be accessed securely over SSL encryption, so that others cannot read it.
technical_task: Provide access to confidential data, such as user details, over SSL encryption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests confidential data, when it is sent to the user, then the connection uses SSL encryption.
Given a connection without SSL encryption, when confidential data is requested, then the data is not delivered.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "secure access".

requirement_text: The ESD requirements for CAN transceivers are specified in the further applicable document `` FV CAN Networking Details '' [A342 000 16 99].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document and states no requirement itself.
clarification_questions: What are the ESD requirements for CAN transceivers?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Support Services shall provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS286] provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an API call to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR are used for telemetry and/or command reception, so that I can assign channels.
technical_task: Provide a Support Services API call that lets the application choose the MPCC channels in a C&T FCR to use for telemetry and/or command reception.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when it calls the API with MPCC channels of a C&T FCR, then those channels are used for telemetry and/or command reception.
Given the API call, when it is used, then the application can specify channels for telemetry, command reception or both.
rationale: Role assumed: application developer.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate group over-runs.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS028] detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate group over-runs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to detect over-runs of the 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups, so that timing problems are noticed.
technical_task: Detect over-runs in the 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups in the scheduler.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz rate group that over-runs, when the scheduler checks it, then the over-run is detected.
Given a 10 Hz or 1 Hz rate group that over-runs, when the scheduler checks it, then the over-run is detected.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall achieve high availability, ensuring videos are accessible even during potential data inconsistencies.
rationale: "High availability" has no measurable target and the inconsistency scenario is not defined.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage is required?
What does "potential data inconsistencies" cover and how should videos behave during them?

requirement_text: The product shall provide Monitoring Services.
rationale: "Monitoring Services" are named without any described behaviour.
clarification_questions: What do the Monitoring Services monitor?
What outputs or alerts must they provide?

requirement_text: System shall maintain database availability through failover mechanisms in case of server failures.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the database to stay available through failover mechanisms when a server fails, so that service continues.
technical_task: Implement failover mechanisms that keep the database available in case of server failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a running database, when a server fails, then the failover mechanism keeps the database available.
Given a failover has happened, when users access the database, then they can still read and write data.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator.

requirement_text: The system shall allow any authorized university group member to add assets to the inventory.
user_story: As a university group member, I want to add assets to the inventory, so that the inventory stays up to date.
technical_task: Allow any authorized university group member to add assets to the inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized university group member, when the member adds an asset, then it is added to the inventory.
Given a user who is not an authorized group member, when the user tries to add an asset, then it is not added.
rationale: Role stated: authorized university group member.

requirement_text: System shall ensure availability by implementing precautions against server failures, such as checkpoints and regular backups, to maintain a stable state for users.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to be protected against server failures with checkpoints and regular backups, so that it stays in a stable state for me.
technical_task: Implement precautions against server failures, such as checkpoints and regular backups, to maintain a stable state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when checkpoints are taken, then the system state can be restored from them.
Given regular backups are made, when a server failure occurs, then the system returns to a stable state.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How often backups run is not stated.

requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation)  to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the Clinical Decision Support capability to conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation), so that authorship and responsibility for data are shown.
technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it is displayed, then its authorship is shown.
Given data in the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it is displayed, then the person responsible for the data is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The content of IN.1.8 is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to include new members in the network through simple administrative tasks.
rationale: "Simple" is subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What counts as a "simple" administrative task?
How many steps or how much time may adding a member take?

requirement_text: Selecting Configure Diagnostics from the File menu shall open the configuration window modally, making it the active window in front of the main window.
user_story: As a user, I want Configure Diagnostics in the File menu to open the configuration window modally in front of the main window, so that I finish configuring before returning.
technical_task: Open the configuration window modally as the active window in front of the main window when Configure Diagnostics is selected from the File menu.
acceptance_criteria: Given the File menu, when the user selects Configure Diagnostics, then the configuration window opens.
Given the configuration window is open, when the user looks at the screen, then it is modal and the active window in front of the main window.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view the operating hours of each recycling facility.
user_story: As a resident, I want to view the operating hours of each recycling facility, so that I know when I can visit.
technical_task: Display the operating hours for each recycling facility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recycling facility, when the user views it, then its operating hours are shown.
Given several recycling facilities, when the user views each, then each shows its own operating hours.
rationale: Role assumed: resident.

requirement_text: System shall redo the transaction if the withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want the transaction to be redone when my withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits, so that I can correct the amount.
technical_task: Redo the transaction when the withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a withdrawal amount that exceeds allowed limits, when the customer submits it, then the transaction is redone.
Given a withdrawal amount within the allowed limits, when the customer submits it, then the transaction is not redone.
rationale: Role assumed: bank customer. What "redo" involves exactly is not described.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to configure and operate a TCP/IP server.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want to configure and operate a TCP/IP server, so that I can provide network services.
technical_task: Provide configuration and operation of a TCP/IP server.
acceptance_criteria: Given the TCP/IP server settings, when the user configures the server, then the configuration is saved.
Given a configured TCP/IP server, when the user starts it, then it operates.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer.

requirement_text: All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.
requirement_text_raw: All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'
user_story: As a new user, I want to be able to use the system after one day of training, so that I can start working soon.
technical_task: Design the system and training so that all users can use the system after one day of training.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has completed one day of training, when the user performs the main tasks, then the user can use the system.
Given all users trained for one day, when they use the system, then each of them can use it.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. "Use the system" is not defined, so the tasks tested are an interpretation.

requirement_text: The list of available follow up actions for a given dispute case must be filtered by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
user_story: As a case handler, I want the follow-up actions for a dispute case to be filtered by the case status and my access level, so that I only see actions I may take.
technical_task: Filter the list of available follow-up actions for a dispute case by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute case with a given status, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions available for that status are listed.
Given a user with a given access level, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions allowed for that access level are listed.
rationale: Role assumed: case handler.

requirement_text: Therefore the RCU doesn't need a special fixation concept.
rationale: The sentence states a conclusion about the design rather than a behaviour, and depends on context not provided.
clarification_questions: What does "special fixation concept" refer to?
What must the RCU provide instead?

requirement_text: For each mission mode, the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries shall be known and fixed.
requirement_text_raw: For each mission mode, the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries shall (3.3.8.1) be known and fixed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries to be known and fixed for each mission mode, so that memory layout is predictable.
technical_task: Define fixed congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries for each mission mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mission mode, when its memory boundaries are examined, then the congruent and non-congruent boundaries are known.
Given a mission mode, when the system runs in it, then the boundaries do not change.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: Intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP, or NE shall not be classified as a fault.
requirement_text_raw: Intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP, or NE shall (3.3.5.32) not be classified as a fault.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP or NE not to be classified as a fault, so that fault reports are accurate.
technical_task: Exclude intentional power-down of an FCP, ICP or NE from fault classification.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP, ICP or NE is powered down intentionally, when the system classifies the event, then it is not classified as a fault.
Given an FCP, ICP or NE stops without being powered down intentionally, when the system classifies the event, then it can be classified as a fault.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall configure the FCP to act as the Radstone IBIT master, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall [SRS237] configure the FCP to act as the Radstone IBIT master, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the FTSS software to configure the FCP as the Radstone IBIT master, except that the ICP on the NEFU is the master, so that one master runs the IBIT tests.
technical_task: Configure the FCP as the Radstone IBIT master from the FTSS software, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software configures an FCP, when it is not on the NEFU, then the FCP acts as the Radstone IBIT master.
Given the NEFU, when the FTSS software configures it, then the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
rationale: Role assumed: system integrator.

requirement_text: User shall easily find what they are looking for on the website, with a simple web design ensuring ease of use.
rationale: "Easily", "simple" and "ease of use" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How quickly or in how many steps should users find what they look for?
What makes the web design "simple" and "easy to use"?

requirement_text: The system shall support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring and control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network, so that I can run and maintain the instrument remotely.
technical_task: Support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the network connection, when an engineer runs a correlator operation, then it runs in real time.
Given the network connection, when an engineer sends a PLD/FPGA personality update, then the update is applied.
rationale: Role assumed: observatory engineer. "Real-time" is not quantified.

requirement_text: System shall allow front-desk staff to assign a unique ID to each patient and add it to the patient’s record.
user_story: As a front-desk staff member, I want to assign a unique ID to each patient and add it to the patient's record, so that each patient can be identified.
technical_task: Allow front-desk staff to assign a unique ID to a patient and store it in the patient's record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient without an ID, when front-desk staff assign a unique ID, then the ID is added to the patient's record.
Given an ID already assigned to a patient, when staff try to assign it to another patient, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: front-desk staff.

requirement_text: Movement shall be facilitated by touching the respective buttons (up, down, left, right) for character movement, with interruptions if there is no light at the destination or if the movement path is blocked.
user_story: As a player, I want to move my character by touching the up, down, left and right buttons, so that I can control it.
technical_task: Move the character when the up, down, left or right button is touched, and interrupt the movement when there is no light at the destination or the movement path is blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Given the movement buttons, when the player touches one, then the character moves in that direction.
Given there is no light at the destination, when the character moves, then the movement is interrupted.
Given the path is blocked, when the character moves, then the movement is interrupted.
rationale: Role assumed: player.

requirement_text: The administrator will maintain a listing of allowable immunizations that an HCP can use.
requirement_text_raw: The administrator will maintain  a listing of allowable immunizations that an HCP can use.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to maintain a listing of allowable immunizations, so that HCPs can choose only from approved ones.
technical_task: Maintain an administrator-managed list of allowable immunizations for HCPs to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of allowable immunizations, when an administrator adds or removes an entry, then the list is updated.
Given an HCP, when the HCP selects an immunization, then only those on the allowable list can be used.
rationale: Role stated: administrator and HCP.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain a memory buffer to store lag frames and track the status of each record in the buffer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a memory buffer that stores lag frames and tracks the status of each record in it, so that lag frames are not lost.
technical_task: Maintain a memory buffer holding lag frames and track the status of every record in the buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Given lag frames arrive, when they are processed, then they are stored in the memory buffer.
Given records in the memory buffer, when their state changes, then the status of each record is tracked.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer.

requirement_text: The system shall handle complex projects and large files without lag or slowdown.
rationale: "Complex", "large" and "without lag or slowdown" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What size counts as a "complex project" or a "large file"?
How much lag or slowdown is tolerable?

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to review code modifications submitted by applicants and associate approved modifications with projects.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to review code modifications submitted by applicants and associate approved ones with projects, so that accepted work is tracked.
technical_task: Provide a review screen for submitted code modifications and a way to link approved modifications to projects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code modification submitted by an applicant, when staff open it, then they can review it.
Given an approved modification, when staff associate it with a project, then it is linked to that project.
rationale: Role stated: staff member and applicant.

requirement_text: All tests shall be performed and passed at the worst case automotive boundary conditions.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want all tests performed and passed at the worst case automotive boundary conditions, so that the product is proven under extreme conditions.
technical_task: Run every test at the worst case automotive boundary conditions and require it to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test, when it is run, then it is run at the worst case automotive boundary conditions.
Given a test run at the worst case automotive boundary conditions, when its result is evaluated, then it has passed.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer. The boundary conditions themselves are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall initiate the play function by selecting the play icon, transitioning the menu screen to the play game screen.
user_story: As a player, I want to start the game by selecting the play icon, so that the menu screen changes to the play game screen.
technical_task: Switch from the menu screen to the play game screen when the user selects the play icon.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menu screen, when the user selects the play icon, then the play game screen is displayed.
Given the play game screen is displayed, when the user looks at the screen, then the menu screen is no longer shown.
rationale: Role assumed: player.

requirement_text: User shall post questions, comments, or discussions related to examinations.
user_story: As a student, I want to post questions, comments or discussions related to examinations, so that I can get help from others.
technical_task: Allow users to post questions, comments and discussions related to examinations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user posts a question, comment or discussion about an examination, then it is published.
Given a published post, when other users view the examination discussion, then the post is visible.
rationale: Role assumed: student.

requirement_text: User shall mark attendance using a selected method.
user_story: As a student, I want to mark my attendance using a selected method, so that my presence is recorded.
technical_task: Allow users to mark attendance using a method they select.
acceptance_criteria: Given the attendance page, when the user selects a method and marks attendance, then the attendance is recorded.
Given attendance marked, when the record is viewed, then it shows the attendance.
rationale: Role assumed: student. The available methods are not listed.
